entries: A creature that touches the hound takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) fire damage.

entries: When hit by a melee attack, the hound deals 2 ({@damage 1d4}) fire damage to the attacker.
